states.claim: image is an acquired Image object; on OpenBlob failure it is destroyed and NULL is returned.
input_filename holds a unique symbolic link path created from image_info->filename; on failure the image is destroyed and NULL is returned.
p points into the command buffer and is advanced while filling it; p is reset to command after each terminated command.
image is closed via CloseBlob before delegate rendering.
image is destroyed before cloning read_info; if delegate_info is NULL, image is destroyed and NULL is returned.
density and options are acquired strings and later destroyed.
read_info is a cloned ImageInfo; its magick field is cleared, its filename is replaced by a unique filename, and it is destroyed after use.
read_info->filename is a unique file resource relinquished after ReadImage.
input_filename is relinquished as a unique file resource after ReadImage.
image is assigned the result of ReadImage; if NULL, a reader exception is thrown.
If image->magick is BMP, ConsolidateCMYKImages may return cmyk_image; when non-NULL, the original image list is destroyed and image is set to cmyk_image.
The image list is traversed by SyncNextImageInList; image is advanced to next_image while next_image is non-NULL.

values.claim: p starts at command and is incremented by one per byte read; the buffer is flushed when (size_t)(p-command) >= MaxTextExtent-1, so at most MaxTextExtent-1 bytes are written before the terminating NUL at *p.
width is computed as (size_t) floor(bounds.x2-bounds.x1+0.5), a real-to-integer conversion of the crop/media box horizontal extent.
height is computed as (size_t) floor(bounds.y2-bounds.y1+0.5), a real-to-integer conversion of the crop/media box vertical extent.
page.width is updated to width only when width > page.width, so page.width is the maximum width seen across parsed boxes.
page.height is updated to height only when height > page.height, so page.height is the maximum height seen across parsed boxes.
page.width and page.height are rescaled by image resolution over delta (DefaultResolution) with floor(x+0.5) and cast to size_t.
geometry is formatted with MaxTextExtent as the size limit using page.width and page.height as doubles.
density is formatted with MaxTextExtent as the size limit using image x/y resolution.
When ping is set, density is reformatted with MagickPathExtent as the size limit.
options is formatted with MaxTextExtent as the size limit using the rescaled page.width and page.height.
options is reformatted with MaxTextExtent as the size limit using read_info->scene and read_info->number_scenes.
filename is copied from read_info->filename with MaxTextExtent as the destination size limit.
command is formatted with MaxTextExtent as the size limit using the delegate command template and arguments including density, options, read_info->filename, and input_filename.

values.claim: image->filename is copied from filename with MaxTextExtent as the destination size limit.
When ping is set, image->magick_columns is multiplied by image->x_resolution/2.0.
When ping is set, image->magick_rows is multiplied by image->y_resolution/2.0.
When ping is set, image->columns is multiplied by image->x_resolution/2.0.
When ping is set, image->rows is multiplied by image->y_resolution/2.0.

executions.claim: If image_info->page is non-NULL, the PCL element parsing loop skips all body processing, so bounds, count, page.width, and page.height remain at their initialized values.

Within the PCL element parsing loop, *p++ is executed before the continue check, so p advances by one for each byte read; the loop body continues without processing only when c is not '/' and not '\n' and p-command < MaxTextExtent-1.
After the CropBox and MediaBox parsing blocks, if count != 4, execution continues to the next loop iteration without updating page.width or page.height.

When count == 4, width and height are computed from bounds.x2-bounds.x1 and bounds.y2-bounds.y1 respectively, then page.width and page.height are updated only if the computed values exceed the current page dimensions.
After the parsing loop, if page.width or page.height is zero, page is set from PSPageGeometry; if image_info->page is non-NULL, page is set from image_info->page.
delegate_info is selected based on image_info->monochrome and cmyk; if it remains NULL, the function destroys the image and returns NULL.
After delegate selection, if page.width or page.height is zero, page is set from PSPageGeometry; if image_info->page is non-NULL, page is set from image_info->page.
page.width and page.height are scaled by image->x_resolution/delta.x and image->y_resolution/delta.y respectively, with floor and +0.5 rounding.
If read_info->number_scenes is nonzero, options is overwritten with page-range arguments; if number_scenes is 1, both -dFirstPage and -dLastPage are set, otherwise only -dLastPage is set.
